parts.text: How many days of sick leave can I take in Singapore before requiring a Medical Certificate (MC), and what is the submission deadline?

Under the Altostrat Singapore policy ([Section 1.1: Outpatient Sick Time & Hospitalization Leave (Singapore)](#sec-1.1) and [Section 19.4: Notification and Medical Certificates (MC)](#sec-19.4)), if you are sick for more than two consecutive work days, you must submit a sick certificate (MC) from a registered medical practitioner via WorkWeek within 48 hours.
What is the paid maternity leave entitlement for eligible female employees in Singapore?

Eligible female employees in Singapore receive up to 16 weeks of paid maternity leave pursuant to Singapore statutory regulations and company policy ([Section 2.1: Maternity Leave (Singapore)](#sec-2.1) / [Section 20.1: Maternity Leave Scope & Entitlement](#sec-20.1)).
Can I claim home office equipment under the remote work policy?
Under [Section 12.2: Remote Work & Ergonomic Allowance](#sec-12.2), eligible full-time employees can claim up to SGD 500 as a one-time ergonomic home office setup reimbursement with valid receipts.
How many days of vacation and sick leave do I have remaining in WorkWeek?

What is the status of my open IT tickets in ServiceImmediately?
Retrieving your tickets from ServiceImmediately for employee EMP-425 shows your active support tickets and their statuses.
Please create an IT support ticket in ServiceImmediately for a broken laptop screen with High priority.
Your ticket for 'Broken laptop screen' under category Hardware with priority 2 - High has been created in ServiceImmediately.
What is the policy for replacement monitors, and can you check if I have any open tickets for hardware in ServiceImmediately?

Under [Section 12.2: Remote Work & Ergonomic Allowance](#sec-12.2), monitor replacements are covered under IT equipment provisions. Checking ServiceImmediately displays your existing hardware tickets.
